$comment: Rotation/mirror semantics for Bedrock directional block states (SPEC.md M2).
Rather than one permutation table per block family, each state property declares
how its values ENCODE a direction. The engine decodes to a semantic name, applies
one shared compass rule, and re-encodes. That way there is a single rotation rule
to get right instead of forty.
A turn is 90 degrees clockwise viewed from above: north -> east -> south -> west.
confidence: 'high'   long-stable Bedrock encoding, safe to rely on.
'medium' believed correct, worth confirming with the probe.
'low'    guessed. MUST be measured before the library is authored.
Run `node tools/gen-rotation-probe.mjs` to produce the in-game probe that
measures anything below 'high', then correct this file from the results.

facing_direction.blocks: ladder, furnace, dropper, dispenser, observer, piston, end_rod, hopper, barrel

direction.blocks: doors, trapdoors, big_dripleaf, cocoa, repeater, comparator
direction.note: Doors are believed to use this order. Trapdoors are the known risk — some references give them east/west/south/north instead. Measure before relying on it.

ground_sign_direction.note: 16 steps of 22.5 degrees. Zero direction confirmed as south; verify the sense of increase with the probe.

minecraft:cardinal_direction.blocks: chest, trapped_chest, furnace family, beehive, lectern, campfire (newer states)

torch_facing_direction.note: Values are 'north'/'south'/'east'/'west'/'top'; 'top' is treated as unrotatable.

pillar_axis.blocks: logs, stripped logs, basalt, quartz pillars, bone block, chains

door_hinge_bit.note: Rotation leaves the hinge alone; either mirror swaps which side it hangs on.

rail_direction.blocks: rail (curved variants); powered/detector/activator rails use 0-5 only

orientation.note: Not needed for the building library. Rotating a jigsaw block is reported as unhandled rather than silently wrong.

faceSuffixedProperties.$comment: Properties whose NAME carries the face, so rotation renames the property rather than changing its value.

unrotatedProperties.$comment: Directional-looking names that are genuinely unaffected by rotation about Y. Listed so the engine's unhandled-property warning stays quiet for them.

suspiciousSubstrings.$comment: A property containing one of these but absent from `properties` and `unrotatedProperties` is reported as unhandled — the safety net for block families nobody has taught the engine about yet.
